lines.en: My hand reaches out of the shadow first.
Hiding at the edge of darkness
Five fingers brace the ground and drag its shadow.

lines.zh: 手臂悬在半空缓缓漂移。
lines.en: The arm drifts slowly through the air.

lines.zh: 五根手指从墙里慢慢伸出来。
lines.en: Five fingers slide slowly out of the wall.
It hangs motionless above the altar.

lines.zh: 指尖微微屈伸，像在数数。
lines.en: Its fingers flex as if counting something.

lines.zh: 腕上的暗影一圈圈缠绕。
lines.en: Shadow coils in rings around its wrist.
It clenches into a fist, then slowly opens.
Aiming at the player, ready to attack
I press to the wall and count your steps.
Following the player, waiting for an opportunity

lines.zh: 掌心朝你张开，五指微曲。
lines.en: Its palm opens toward you, fingers curling.

lines.zh: 它停在你脸前，指尖发凉。
lines.en: It stops before your face, fingertips cold.

lines.zh: 一根手指跟着你的呼吸走。
lines.en: One finger follows the rhythm of your breath.

lines.zh: 半只手从你的影子里探出。
lines.en: Half a hand pushes out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 指节敲了敲空气，像敲门。
lines.en: Its knuckles tap the air as if knocking.
It tests a touch at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 拇指擦过你的喉咙又收回。
lines.en: A thumb brushes your throat and withdraws.
Black blood seeps from your wounds!

lines.zh: 你的光芒引来了我的注意！
你手里的光，让我想靠近。
lines.en: The light in your hand draws me closer.

lines.zh: 你身上的光对我来说太耀眼了。
lines.en: The light on you is too blinding.

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，不然你会付出代价。
lines.en: Stay away, or you'll pay the price.

lines.zh: 你的火焰让我感到恐惧。
我是黑暗的一部分，无法被驱散。
lines.en: I am a part of the dark, unscattered.

lines.zh: 光让我感到不适，远离我。
lines.en: Light is uncomfortable to me, stay away.

lines.zh: 我伸过来的时候，你已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time my hand reaches, you're late.

lines.zh: 我的触手渴望你的灵魂。
你身上的暗影力量吸引我。
lines.en: The dark shadows on you attract me.
Don't think you'll live to leave.
You stand where it is too bright; step back.
I'll hold you, and I won't let go.

lines.zh: 暗影从你的鞋底爬上来。
lines.en: Shadow climbs up from your soles.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过你的影子，抓住你。
lines.en: My hand passes through your shadow and grips you.
In the dark, I want to hold someone's hand.

lines.zh: 握住我的手，就放不开了。
lines.en: Take my hand — you won't let go.
Two hands, just right to hold you.

lines.zh: 与我一起，你将拥有永恒。
lines.en: With me, you will have eternity.

lines.zh: 影子缠在一起，就算是承诺。
lines.en: If our shadows coil together, that is a promise.
Choose me, and you won't be alone.

lines.zh: 与我一起，你将不受侵扰。
lines.en: With me, you will be unbothered.

lines.zh: 摸到它，如同触电般刺痛。
lines.en: Touching it feels like an electric shock.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤像夜色般冰冷。

lines.en: It slowly emerges from the shadows.

lines.zh: 黑暗中伸出冰冷的手指。
lines.en: Cold fingers extend from the darkness.
It silently hides in the darkness.
Its movements are slow and eerie.
A piece of your shadow is missing.

lines.zh: 黑暗中伸出一只薄薄的手。
lines.en: A thin hand reaches out of the dark.

lines.zh: 墙上的影子多了一只手臂。
lines.en: The shadow on the wall has an extra arm.
Its knuckles crack. You are chosen.
The shadow moves first, the hand follows.
It has grabbed hold of your shadow.

lines.zh: 一根手指竖起，叫你别动。
它握紧，像捏住一只虫子。
lines.en: It closes as if around an insect.

lines.zh: 它从祭坛后伸出来够你。
lines.en: It reaches for you from behind the altar.
Its gaze is locked on you.

lines.zh: 影子伸出一只手，抓住了光。
lines.en: A hand reaches out of the shadow and grips the light.

lines.zh: 我顺着你影子的边缘往上爬。
lines.en: I climb along the edge of your shadow.
It will not give up easily.
One hand is all I need.

lines.zh: 等你把背转向墙，我就动手。
lines.en: When you turn your back to the wall, I strike.
A thumb presses on your pulse.

lines.zh: 它摸到你袖里藏的东西。
lines.en: It finds what you hide in your sleeve.
Five fingers spread to measure your throat.

lines.zh: 它顺着你的手臂往上游。
lines.en: It crawls up along your arm.
Cold climbs from your wrist to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它绕到背后扣住你的衣领。
lines.en: It slips behind you and hooks your collar.
Black mist leaks between its fingers.

lines.zh: 它把你的头发绕在指上。
lines.en: It winds your hair around a finger.

lines.zh: 掌心贴住你的背，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: Its palm settles on your back and tightens.
Five fingers dig into your shoulder!
Its knuckles sweep across your face!
A palm slams your chest with a dull thud!

lines.zh: 它拧住你的衣领往上提！
lines.en: It twists your collar and lifts!
A fingertip opens a cold line on your skin!
It pins you against the wall!

lines.zh: 一只手从地里抓住你的脚！
lines.en: A hand grabs your ankle from the ground!
It moves silently in the dark!

lines.zh: 祭坛上的影子立起一只手。
lines.en: A hand rises from the shadow on the altar.
Five fingers squeeze out of a crack in the wall.
An arm reaches out of the dark.

lines.zh: 受诅的灵魂留下了这只手。
lines.en: A cursed soul left this hand behind.
It crawls out from behind the candlelight.
Something knocks beneath the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 一只手无声地悬在半空。
lines.en: A hand hangs silently in the air.

lines.zh: 暗影做的手，怕起火来了。
lines.en: A hand made of shadow — and it fears fire.
A hand of shadow can't grip the ground.

lines.zh: 火光把我的手指震散了。

lines.en: The spell shone right through my shadow.

lines.zh: 雷光一亮，我的形状淡了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and my shape fades.
